plan.notes: TERM-BY-TERM SEQUENCE: official SIU Carbondale curricular guide (major map) PDF, 'B.A. Radio, Television & Digital Media: Media Industries 2020-2021 Major Map for First Tim'. Two-column YEAR N – Semester M layout transcribed in catalog order. Minimum grades (e.g. 'C') shown in the guide are not transcribed as prereqs. 'X/Y' alternatives use the first-listed option as the plan code. REPEATED COURSES: RTD 3XX marks upper-level RTD categories; the guide reuses the code for different selections.
